strings.consent.title: Room decorating is processed by AI overseas
strings.consent.lead: When you ask to decorate, the information below is sent to an AI provider's servers overseas. Without consent, the day count and viewing the room still work.
strings.consent.sent.label: What's sent
strings.consent.purpose.label: Purpose
strings.consent.purpose.body: To create a room preview that matches your request
strings.consent.processor.label: Processed by
strings.consent.processor.body: Anthropic PBC (United States). Sent through Aroom's servers.
strings.consent.keep.label: Retention and withdrawal
strings.consent.provider.keep: Provider retention period: [fill in after legal review]
strings.consent.couple.label: This room is shared by two
strings.consent.withdraw.title: Withdraw your consent?
strings.consent.withdraw.body: After you withdraw, requests are no longer sent overseas. The room stays as it is, and you'll need to agree again to decorate.
strings.consent.later.note: You can't decorate until you agree. Viewing the room and the day count are unaffected.
